title: Object Storage
description: Connect an S3-compatible bucket so cloud models receive images and videos by URL instead of inline data. Works with Tencent COS, Alibaba OSS, and any S3-compatible service.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: Bucket location and identity. Changes save automatically when you finish editing.
connection.endpointDescription: S3-compatible service endpoint, must begin with https://
connection.regionDescription: Region code where the bucket is hosted
connection.publicBaseUrlDescription: Optional public bucket domain or CDN that serves the uploaded objects.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: Credentials are stored in the local secrets database and saved automatically.

actions.loadFailed: Could not read object storage settings

validation.endpointInvalid: Endpoint must be an https:// URL with a host.
validation.bucketInvalid: Bucket must be 3–63 characters of lowercase letters, numbers, '.' or '-'.
validation.publicBaseUrlInvalid: Public base URL must be an https:// URL with a host.
